text:
lucy: Noticed a spike of SCIM deprovision failures after today's entitlement cleanup. Okta is returning 503s for a subset and our KMS client shows decrypt errors. Can we triage?

ryan: On it. Any sample request_id or logs? Also which customers are impacted?

lucy: Example log: 
```
2026-03-21T02:11:12Z ERROR scim-handler request_id=cc7a9f3e svc=svc-scim region=us-west status=503 upstream=okta
2026-03-21T02:11:12Z ERROR kms-decrypt request_id=cc7a9f3e err="jwe: incorrect envelope header" key_ref=alias/redwood/primary
```
Customers: 3 enterprise tenants flagged in #support (ids in ticket 7892).

devops: We rolled KMS alias earlier today (alias/redwood/primary -> alias/redwood/primary-v2) during scheduled maintenance. Also deployed rbac-cleanup job at 01:45 UTC that removed legacy scim roles on a handful of infra service accounts.

kms-audit-bot: alert: KMS decrypt error rate increased 42x between 01:30-02:15 UTC. Sample key-ids observed in failed envelopes: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-v2

ryan: Two hypotheses: (A) decrypt fails because pods still use old alias mapping (env still points to alias/redwood/primary) while envelopes are encrypted with v2 key, (B) RBAC removal revoked permissions that an intermediate service uses to read wrapped key metadata, causing abort before audit emission.

lucy: I grepped deployments: scim-worker had two replicas with KMS_ALIAS=alias/redwood/primary, others point to primary-v2. One of those replicas is in cluster eu-west where the env update didn't roll.

devops: Rolling restart the affected deployment now: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/scim-worker`. Also patching the env var via k8s patch.

okta-bot: Okta response for request_id=cc7a9f3e status=503 retry-after=20s

ryan: Please avoid changing alias mappings. Alias flips can cause a mix of envelopes that different consumers can't decrypt. Restarting pods to pick up the new alias string (primary-v2) is safer.

compliance: Note for audit — any lack of scim.deprovision events is a PII compliance concern. If audit entries were dropped, we need to backfill and attach logs to ticket for SOC review.

lucy: Agreed. I'm holding backfill until pods are stable. If pods can't decrypt, the code bails and we don't emit scim.deprovision. That's why support saw missing audits.

ryan: Quick checks I'm doing: (1) query KMS Access logs for decrypt attempts with request_id cc7a9f3e, (2) list pods with old env var, (3) check rbac-cleanup job for service accounts removed.

kms-audit-bot: KMS access: decrypt failures for request_id=cc7a9f3e show ciphertext encrypted-by=key/abcd-v2.

lucy: Found one service account (svc-scim-reaper) that lost `scim.manage` during RBAC cleanup. It runs a sidecar that fetches wrapped keys; losing that permission would cause decrypts to fail pre-audit.

devops: I restored the role to svc-scim-reaper temporarily and restarted the pod. Rolling restart finished.

okta-bot: Okta provisioning retry passed for request_id=cc7a9f3e status=200

lucy: After restoring role and pod restarts, failures dropped to baseline. No new 503s for 10m.

ryan: Next steps: (A) do not modify alias mappings; (B) run backfill to replay failed SCIM messages once we confirm all consumers decrypt; backfill command: `python infra/tools/replay_deadletter.py --queue scim-deprovision-dlq --since 2026-03-21T01:30:00Z --confirm`; (C) attach KMS audit entries and pod env diff to ticket.

compliance: Please ensure backfill preserves original timestamps and ordering for audit integrity. We'll run checks against `scim.deprovision` entries after replay.

lucy: Will coordinate replay. Also opening postmortem notes: add pre-rotate checklist for aliases (cluster-wide env sweep + smoke test), add RBAC cleanup smoke tests targeted at SCIM/service-account flows, and change audit-emitter to record a placeholder event on decrypt failure so we don't drop audit rows.

ryan: Agreed on placeholder audit. That reduces compliance risk while we recover. Also add a canary step in the KMS alias rotation runbook: verify all clusters see new alias string for 15m before switching traffic.

devops: Filed rollback flag for rbac-cleanup job and pinned the deployment to previous revision for 30m while we validate.

lucy: Thanks everyone. I'll update the incident ticket with logs and the replay outcome. Closing loop when backfill completes. :thumbsup:

kms-audit-bot: reminder: attach KMS arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-v2 access logs to the ticket for retention 7y per policy.

okta-bot: final status for request_id=cc7a9f3e: succeeded after replay.

lucy: Incident resolved for now. Postmortem to follow.
